normalization_plan.reason: _to is a pure argument of transfer(address,uint256,bytes); it has no independent state semantics and should be folded into the transfer function node
_value is an argument consumed by transfer; fold into the transfer function node
_data is forwarded into the external tokenFallback call and only matters for the unsafe external-call operation
_from is a local argument of transferFrom and should be merged into that function node
_owner is only a lookup key for balanceOf/allowance and should collapse into the view function
_spender only parameterises the allowance-writing functions and should merge into approve
_addedValue is the sole operand of increaseApproval and should merge into that function
_subtractedValue is the sole operand of decreaseApproval and should merge into that function
_newOwner is the only argument of changeOwner and should merge into that function
_transfersEnabled is the only argument of enableTransfers and should merge into that function
constructor _owner only initialises state inside the constructor and should merge into it
codeLength is a transient local deciding whether the reentrancy-prone external call executes
empty is a transient bytes local passed to tokenFallback and should merge into that external-call operation
oldValue is a transient snapshot used only inside decreaseApproval and should merge into it
receiver is a transient cast of _to used only for the external tokenFallback call
